Read-only access to a tile, with toroidal wrapping.
Draws a string at a screen position (the pen starts on the baseline).
Whether a tile is currently selected.

Read-only access to the map.

Width of the HUD panel in pixels for a given window width.

Looks up a shader by id.

Binds the program for subsequent draw calls.

Computes the row-major storage index for wrapped coordinates.
Y (bottom-left origin) of the time-unit line, derived from the window height.
